title: Summary: The Capstone
objective: Finish the core checker: count the checks that failed, print the pass count, and print a passed or failed result.
hint: Include Test-Tool as before, and the ordered $checks list. Then $failed = @($checks.Values | Where-Object { $_ -ne "ok" }).Count. Print Passed, the pass count, of, and the total. Then an if with $failed -gt 0 that prints Result: failed, and an else that prints Result: passed.
